data.name: Lubaina
data.gender_notes: Lubaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'lubana' which means 'giver of light'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Lubaina represents the spiritual enlightenment and guidance that comes from following the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Lubaina carries the meaning “Light-giving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lubaina usually hope their child will grow to embody light-giving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with light and guidance, inspiring those who bear it to seek knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Lubaina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light-giving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubaina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: لُبَيْنَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لُبَيْنَة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من اللبن، ويعني النعمة والجمال والبركة، ويتضمن هذا الاسم دلالة على الخير والصلاح، وهو اسم مشهور في التراث الإسلامي وتحمل ihn العديد من الصحابيات

in_urdu.name: لُبَینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: لُبَینہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو لُبن سے مشتق ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نعمتی اور خوبصورتی، اور یہ نام برکت اور خیر کی دلالت کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت مشہور ہے

in_hindi.name: लुबैना
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ है आशीर्वाद और सुंदरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुबैना एक अरबी नाम है जो लुबन से उत्पन्न हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है आशीर्वाद और सुंदरता, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है और इसका महत्व इस्लामिक परंपरा में बहुत अधिक है
